title: SGLang controlled tuning and model-quality gates
summary: Filter invalid configurations before accelerator trials and rank only candidates that satisfy frozen quality, latency, error and memory constraints.

zh-CN.title: SGLang 受控调优与模型质量门槛
zh-CN.summary: 加速器实验前过滤无效配置，只比较满足预设质量、延迟、错误率及内存约束的候选。

conditions: Freeze workload distribution, trial budget, model/tokenizer, revision, topology and numerical tolerance.
Preserve arrival process, warmup, cache policy, output/EOS behavior and measurement duration.

recommendations: Classify candidates as existing knobs, implementation changes or research extensions and compare one causal family first.
Keep successful/failed counts, token counts, queueing, latency distributions, memory and cache/speculation statistics with raw artifacts.
validation_plan: Check logits/logprobs, cache hit/miss, chunked/unchunked, speculative/baseline and intended topology consistency before ranking.
Repeat paired trials to expose variance and retain rejected candidates; run representative model quality and service checks.
limitations: A single random-input throughput score or kernel parity test does not establish production performance.
Set tolerances from the reference and dtype before search; do not relax them to accept a candidate.
This indexed abstract links to the complete English skill and source evidence; it is imported guidance, not a benchmark result.
Accelerator execution, real-model quality and service performance remain unverified for this import. Qualify each target revision, model, backend and workload separately.
